# Parley v0.1.72

This unnotarized test beta makes a workspace of one vendor's panes work as
well as a mixed one, adds a tab view for a workspace's panes, and keeps a
parent Claude Code session's variables out of every pane. The agent protocol
moves to 35, so running agent panes show **RESTART FOR PROTOCOL** after
installing. Saved data is unchanged.

## Several panes of one vendor

A workspace may hold several Claude panes (or several of any vendor). Before
this build each was named after its vendor, so Ask menus showed identical
rows and `parley ask claude` could never resolve.

- **Name and role at creation.** The launch review has an IDENTITY section:
  a name, proposed as "Claude 2" only when "Claude" is already taken in the
  workspace, and an optional routing role checked as you type. Rename now
  refuses a slash or a leading `@`, since either makes a pane unaddressable.
- **Distinct labels.** Ask menus and the command palette show the name alone
  where it is unique, and add the role, the folder, then the pane id only
  where names collide.
- **A refusal that teaches.** An ambiguous target is refused with each
  candidate's workspace, name and role, and only the addresses that reach
  that pane alone from the asking pane: `@role`, name, `Workspace/@role`,
  `Workspace/Name` or the pane id.
- **Protocol 35.** Agents are told to address a pane by name, `@role` or
  pane id. A name, role or vendor is looked for among the other panes of
  the sender's own workspace first, then across workspaces only when none
  there match, and must match exactly one, so the vendor alone is refused
  while several panes share it. An agent is also told that
  its own name and role are in `parley whoami`, and to say which pane it is
  when it asks or delegates.
- **Pair template.** New Workspace from Template offers a Pair for each
  vendor: an Implementer (`@implementer`, the workspace lead) and a Reviewer
  (`@reviewer`) side by side in one folder you choose. Both stay stopped
  until you review each Start.

## Workspace tabs

Each workspace can show its panes as a grid, as before, or as tabs: one pane
at a time under a tab strip. The choice is per workspace and survives
relaunch.

- Switch with the Tabs/Grid toolbar button, Navigate › Show Panes as Tabs,
  the workspace menu's Show Panes as, the command palette or
  Command-Shift-T.
- Each tab shows the vendor monogram, the name, the role, the handoff wire
  and the attention or state chip, so a hidden pane that needs you is still
  visible. Right-click a tab for the pane's menu. Command-1…9, Next and
  Previous Pane, the sidebar and the Ask menus bring a pane's tab forward.
- Hidden tabs keep running and take handoffs exactly as panes in another
  workspace do. Starting or restarting a pane from a hidden tab brings it
  forward (a team member's pane comes forward without taking focus), because
  a terminal starts only once drawn.
- Zoom and Balance are grid-only. Switching back to Grid restores the same
  split arrangement and divider positions.
- Copilot submits only in a focused pane, so a handoff to a Copilot pane
  that is not on screen (a hidden tab or another workspace) is now refused
  before anything is typed. Show the pane, then send again: an open draft
  sends as it stands, a relay offers Retry Delivery, and an Ask or Delegate
  offers Ask or Delegate This Again in Status Center. Before this build a
  Copilot pane in another workspace got its text pasted but not submitted.

## A parent session's variables stay out

Parley started from inside a Claude Code session (a development build run
from an agent's shell, for one) handed that session's markers to every pane,
which turned transcript saving off in Claude panes. Every pane, container
client and reviewed command run now starts without the parent's `TMUX`,
`TMUX_PANE` and Claude Code session variables. Your own Claude configuration
(`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`, `ANTHROPIC_*`, `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_*`) passes through.
Parley opened from the Dock or Finder never had these variables, so it
behaves as before.

## Going back to v0.1.71

v0.1.71 reads everything v0.1.72 saves. It ignores a workspace's tab
setting and shows the grid; names and roles set at creation stay.

## Validation and known limits

The release workflow repeats the following before publishing this beta:
- the deterministic checks and the repository scans;
- the app build and the 25-round Ghostty soak;
- packaging, checksums and packaged-launch verification.

Checked before the pull requests merged: 642 native checks and both scans
in a Command Line Tools Tart VM on the combined tree, the 25-round soak on
each change, and the checks on GitHub's hosted runner; 82 script tests on
the release branch. Codex reviewed the identity and tab changes
independently through Parley delegations, then checked the fixes. Every
finding was applied except one older limit: a pane that finishes starting
in a workspace you are not looking at (a team container member, for one)
starts its terminal only when you show that workspace and its tab.

None of this has been hand-tested in a built app. The scenarios are in
docs/test-scenarios.md: "Single-vendor workspaces" (the IDENTITY section, the
labels, the Pair template, an ambiguous `parley ask claude`) and "P3.9
Workspace tabs" (toggling, hidden tabs taking handoffs, starting a pane from
a hidden tab, a Copilot pane off screen, relaunch).

v0.1.71 was once seen using most of a CPU core after twelve days running
with a long handoff history, and its agents then reported that the relay
broker was not running. That is not fixed here. If it happens, quit and
reopen Parley.

Agy's loading of Parley's instructions from its added folder is still
unverified, fresh or resumed.

This is an ad-hoc-signed, unnotarized test beta. It does not update the
stable Sparkle feed or Homebrew cask. Follow the included installation
instructions.
